title.narrative: West Bengal Drinking Water Sector Improvement Project

description.narrative: The project will provide safe and sustainable drinking water as per the standards set by the Government of India to about 1.65 million people in the arsenic, fluoride, and salinity- affected selected areas of Bankura, North 24 Parganas and Purba Medinipur districts of West Bengal (project districts). It will introduce an innovative and sustainable institutional framework and advanced technology for smart water management to enable efficient service delivery in project districts.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Grant 9196: 28% of contracts awarded and 15% disbursed as of 04 Jul 2025
Loan 3696: 99% of contracts awarded and 72% disbursed as of 04 Jul 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: The project is under implementation.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Nov 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49107/49107-006-apfs-en_4.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Jul 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49107/49107-006-iee-en_54.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Oct 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49107/49107-006-rp-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Jul 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49107/49107-006-sddr-en_20.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49107/49107-006-smr-en_15.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Total 5,345 km of additional pipeline laid in project districts (North 24 Pargana, East Medinipur and Bankura. For (i) North 24 Pargana: Households survey completed, capturing data for 93,240 households; (ii) Bankura: Completed, capturing data for 1,21,000 HHs; and (iii) East Medinipur: Households survey completed. For (i) North 24 Parganas: Construction of 100 MLD WTP in progress; (ii) Bankura: Construction of 44 MLD and 36 MLD WTP in progress; and (iii) East Medinipur - Construction of 112 MLD WTP in progress. For (i) North 24 Parganas: Construction in progress at 30 Storage reservoir sites; (ii) Bankura: Construction in progress at 54 Storage reservoir sites; and (iii) East Medinipur: Construction in progress at 15 Storage reservoir sites. For (i) North 24 Parganas: Construction is in progress for water treatment plan and work completed at 16 out 39 OHRs; and (ii) Bankura: work is in progress for storage reservoirs. District-wise DWQAP report submitted by PMC. Water Safety Plan for districts of North 24 Pargana and Bankura developed and approved. Fecal sludge and septage management expert engaged and mobilized. Draft report has been prepared by the expert. Implementation of awareness campaigns are being undertaken in all 3 districts. More than 40% female participation reported in awareness campaigns conducted so far. Flood forecasting and early warning system modelling with secondary data completed. Training module preparation is ongoing. Poverty mapping and identification of female and male candidates for skill training were substantially completed. Resolution from all 66 GPs for implementation of AMSDF has been obtained and process for ensuring adoption by the project team panchayats is under progress. Smart water management application has been rolled out in three sample GPs. Gender strategy for PHED is being under preparation.
